description: Connect Bastion to ChatGPT to manage your security and compliance posture through natural conversation. Review framework compliance status across SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. Drill into failing tests, upload evidence, and submit controls for review. Ask your knowledge base security and compliance questions grounded in your own policies and documentation. Monitor code security findings and GitHub configuration status. All data is scoped to your authenticated account - you only ever see your own tenant.
